title: CFA lane 1: quantitative methods (statistics for finance)
mission: Curate atomic, reusable algebraic quantitative-methods relationships used across CFA levels I-III: returns, means, dispersion, probability rules, sampling arithmetic, and regression/time-series closed forms, each with explicit population/sample scope and frequency conventions. Descriptive and definitional arithmetic only; continue through successive batches with no inference chain required.
priorities: Holding-period, arithmetic-mean, geometric-mean and money-weighted return definitions
Variance, standard deviation and coefficient of variation for a stated population or sample
Probability rules used in finance: complement, addition, multiplication and total probability with stated dependence
Expected value, variance and covariance of discrete outcomes with stated probabilities
Standardization (z-scores) and location/scale arithmetic with stated mean and dispersion
Correlation and covariance identities with stated scope
Simple linear regression closed forms (slope, intercept, R-squared decomposition) where expressible without iteration
Time-weighted vs money-weighted return comparison scaffolding as separate definitional records
boundaries: This lane owns statistics-flavored finance formulas; valuation, statements, fixed income, derivatives and portfolio records belong to lanes 2-6.
Do not resubmit the 14 covered TVM-family IDs as new coverage; record overlaps instead (see curator brief).
Hypothesis-test mechanics are descriptive formulas only (test statistics, rejection arithmetic); no p-value computation beyond closed forms, no statistical advice.
Exclude iterative estimation, maximum likelihood, simulations, and anything needing operators outside the kit snapshot; defer with exact sources.
Annualization and frequency conversions follow the canonical-units rule: factors live in unit scales/constants metadata, never inlined in expressions.
starter_sources: Owner excerpt packet for this lane (discovery leads with exact PDF locators; corroborate every record against a directly inspected accessible source).

A public statistics or finance textbook with the same formulas (for example OpenStax Introductory Statistics or Principles of Finance); record exact book, edition and section, never cite a root URL as evidence.
special_checks: State population vs sample scope on every dispersion record; guard sample size above 1 where denominators require it.
Keep probability, odds and frequency meanings distinct; a number in [0,1] is not automatically a probability.
Annualized vs periodic quantities must carry explicit frequency in meaning, units and context.
Test a degenerate case (zero variance, single observation, boundary probability) as a guard or rejection case, not a silent clamp.
integration_expectation: Most meanings (holding_period_return, sample_variance, z_score, correlation and similar) are new and require extension; all seed forms are scalar with integer powers and fit the engine once meanings exist. Period counts stay dimensionless; physical durations use duration. Never relabel a return as a discount rate or a variance as a price to force execution.
coverage_guidance: Priorities are seeds, not a finite checklist. Continue into adjacent QM readings inside the boundaries, selecting independently reusable relationships. Save multiple bounded batches without waiting for owner review. Check supplied inventory and prior returns for equivalent relationships and conflicting IDs. Record out-of-format discoveries as deferred with exact sources and missing capabilities; do not force chains or dilute quality for a quota.
